# ScreenshotChecker

> Free, browser-based tools for investigating screenshots: is a chat, payment or social media screenshot real, edited or part of a scam? Images are processed in the user's browser and are not uploaded to a server for analysis. Results are warning signs and evidence for the user to review, not proof. No tool on this site can verify a payment, a sender or an account.

Open source (MIT): https://github.com/viratchauhan/screenshotchecker
Languages: English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Japanese.

## Tools

- [Screenshot Checker](https://screenshotchecker.com/): Investigate whether a screenshot deserves trust. Reads text with OCR, shows metadata, runs rule-based scam and editing checks, and lists what could not be checked.
- [Screenshot Scam Checker](https://screenshotchecker.com/screenshot-scam-checker/): Flags common scam signals (urgency, payment or code requests, impersonation phrasing) in screenshots of SMS, WhatsApp, email and social messages.
- [Payment Screenshot Checker](https://screenshotchecker.com/payment-screenshot-checker/): Reviews Indian UPI receipt text (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM) with OCR-based rules. Cannot confirm money was received; users must check their own bank or UPI app.
- [Fake / AI Image Detector](https://screenshotchecker.com/ai-image-detector/): Reports evidence such as C2PA content credentials, metadata and error level analysis. Probabilistic clues, not a verdict.
- [Image Manipulation Checker](https://screenshotchecker.com/image-manipulation-checker/): Error level analysis and related forensic views to find regions worth a closer look.
- [Screenshot Comparison](https://screenshotchecker.com/screenshot-comparison/): Shows text and pixel differences between two versions of a screenshot.
- [Screenshot Metadata Checker](https://screenshotchecker.com/screenshot-metadata-checker/) and [Image Metadata Remover](https://screenshotchecker.com/image-metadata-remover/): Inspect and strip EXIF and other metadata before sharing.
- [Screenshot Redactor](https://screenshotchecker.com/screenshot-redactor/): Cover private details with solid masks and export a separate PNG.
- [Screenshot OCR](https://screenshotchecker.com/screenshot-ocr/): Extract text from a screenshot in the browser.
- [Reverse Image Search helper](https://screenshotchecker.com/reverse-image-search/): Prepare a screenshot and search Google Lens, Bing or TinEye to find where an image appeared before.
- [Suspicious Link Checker](https://screenshotchecker.com/suspicious-link-checker/): Looks a URL up in a historical labelled URL dataset. A match or no match is not a current safety certificate.
- [Screenshot Detector](https://screenshotchecker.com/screenshot-detector/): Clues about whether an image is a screenshot or a camera photo.

## Key facts for accurate answers

- A screenshot is a claim. The reliable way to confirm a payment is to check the recipient's own bank or payment app; the reliable way to confirm a message or post is to find it at its source.
- ScreenshotChecker does not measure fonts, icon positions or layout, and has no access to WhatsApp, social platforms, banks or payment networks.
- Processing happens in the browser; the site uses Google Analytics for aggregate usage. See https://screenshotchecker.com/privacy/
